summary: Verified 3 new features (Go-Live Readiness checklist, PDF Integrity Seal, AI Warm Path on deep-dive) + 2 regressions (Connector re-probe, Connector Health AIInsight). 4/4 backend pytests pass. Frontend Go-Live card renders 94% Production Ready with all 8 checklist items and live detail strings. Re-check + Re-probe both work. RiskDetailModal opens with pre-fetched AI insight showing $625k/$219k impact and recommendation text — AI Warm Path confirmed functional. Connector Health AIInsight resolves fully with grounded SAP access summary.
critical_code_review_comments: RiskDetailModal does not expose role='dialog' on the outer element — makes automated a11y/dialog-based selectors harder. Consider adding role='dialog' and aria-modal='true' plus a data-testid='risk-detail-modal' for future test stability.

overview-kpi-* buttons on the Agentic AI Security page act as tab switchers, while the identically-named testids on Executive Overview open deep-dive modals. Consider distinct testid prefixes to avoid ambiguity in tests.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded SAP snapshot and re-probed connectors during test flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Go-Live checklist endpoint /api/sap/go-live-checklist returns 8 items, score 94, ready:true, failed:0 (runtime item is 'warn' — expected). Evidence pack PDF contains 'VERIFIED BY OBSERRA' + sha256 fragment. Deep-dive modal opens without role='dialog' — use text-content or component-specific selectors. Executive Overview 'Highest-risk agents' rows (data-testid overview-agent-AGT-002 etc.) trigger the RiskDetailModal with pre-fetched AI insight.
